result.title: Corpus Explorer — React web workbench over the chunk database

answers.answer: Built SPA served by existing notebooklm-server at /ui + new /v1/corpus routes
Vite + React + TS + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + TanStack Query/Table

Hybrid RRF search with per-leg score breakdown (keyword rank, vector rank, fused score) and query-term highlighting
Chunk browser: virtualized table filterable by notebook, document, run, topic, fact-check status, length
Chunk detail pane: parent context with child highlighted, neighbor sentences, spaCy tokens/entities, SFL features
Delete chunks (single + bulk), logged to removal_log
RAG answer: streaming LLM answer over retrieved chunks with inline citations linking to chunks
Correlate: 'more like this' nearest-neighbor chunks by embedding distance
Correlate: 2D embedding scatter (UMAP/PCA) colored by topic/document, click to open chunk
Ingestion run dashboard: chunk_runs stats, live progress while ingestion runs
Multi-select bulk actions (delete, export, re-fact-check)
Export selected chunks to Markdown/JSON or push as a NotebookLM note
Cmd-K command palette and full keyboard navigation (j/k, /, etc.)

Hard delete + cascade + removal_log row
Granularity: single clause (child chunk)
Granularity: parent chunk with its children
Granularity: whole document or ingestion run
Undo toast (delayed commit) instead of confirm dialogs
